item.title: Off the Menu 2.0.0
item.description: V2.0.0 — the big one. WAVE RETRY: losing restarts only the wave (score and super roll back to wave-start; banked XP is never lost). SUPER MOVES: kills charge a meter, TAB fires — Jax's Super Fart, Pip's Sentry Shriek, Zola's Pronk Shockwave, Ziggy's Dazzle Delirium, Boulder's Shellquake, Legs' Dust Devil. SAVES: multiple timestamped runs, a save menu, and CONTINUE that only exists when a save does. A new arena every wave (grove, rock field, waterhole, termite mounds, canyon), a thorn-scrub ring you cannot leave, per-hero light and predator mixes, true exclusive fullscreen, and JAX'S STORY — the origin intro, playing once on first launch. (Also contains the whole 1.3.0 herd release and the RSA update verifier, so future updates verify on stock macOS.)
